findings.F1: Sunday is the only day whose move clearly reverses over the next 3 days. The correlation of the Sunday bar's vol-scaled return with the next 3 days' excess over drift is -0.094 (p < 0.0001, n = 4320). Every other weekday lies between -0.021 and +0.051.
findings.F2: The Sunday reversal works on both sides of the move. Sunday rises are followed by -1.02 % against drift over 3 days (t -5.48). Sunday falls are followed by +0.97 % (t +4.67).
findings.F3: Across Sunday quintiles of the scaled return, the next 3 days' excess falls from +1.37 % (t 3.86) through +1.11 %, -0.54 % and -1.17 % to -0.97 % (t -3.05) at the top. The effect is graded across the whole range but flattens among the largest rises, which matches the tested short-only plan's weighted correlation of -0.001.
findings.F4: The Fri-to-Sun two-day weekend move, scaled the same way, predicts nothing. Its quintiles give +0.43 %, -0.07 %, -0.56 %, -0.14 % and +0.13 %, all with |t| ≤ 2.1. The reversal belongs to Sunday's own bar.
findings.F5: Sunday rises reverse most in coins that were already falling. After a 20-day decline (mean -17.5 %) the 3-day excess is -1.58 % (t -5.62). It is -0.72 % (t -2.80) in the flat tercile and -0.75 % (t -1.84) after a 20-day rise of +36 %.
findings.F6: Low weekend volume does not grade the reversal, contrary to the brief. Sunday-rise terciles of weekend volume against the 20-day mean give -1.44 % (t -5.26), -0.45 % (t -1.41) and -1.16 % (t -3.16).
findings.F7: The Sunday-rise shortfall is spread over most coins and years. It is negative in 17 of 19 coins and in 7 of 8 years, strongest in 2018 (-3.69 %, t -4.10) and 2024 (-1.74 %, t -3.82), and weak in 2020–2023 (|t| ≤ 1.2).
findings.F8: Weekday moves do not reverse, in contrast to Sunday. Wednesday rises of more than one vol continue over the next 3 days (+1.52 %, t 4.10, n = 765), and so do Thursday rises (+1.03 %, t 2.49).

ideas.idea: A coin's Sunday close-to-close return, measured against its 20-day volatility of daily returns, is followed by a move the other way over the next 3 days. After a Sunday fall the coin beats its normal drift, after a Sunday rise it falls behind, and the larger the Sunday move, the larger the move back.
ideas.consequence: Lean against the Sunday move on both sides for the first three days of the week: buy after a Sunday fall and lighten or short after a Sunday rise.
ideas.name: Sunday move reverses both ways

ideas.idea: A coin that rose on Sunday, measured against its 20-day volatility, falls behind its normal drift over the next 3 days by more the further it fell over the past 20 days.
ideas.consequence: Refuse to buy, or short, a Sunday rise in a coin that has been falling for three weeks, more so the deeper its decline.
ideas.name: Sunday bounce in downtrend fades
